notes.title: Akumi Wars 0.0.16 - Map bug fix
notes.notes:

• Fixed autoplay visual bug
• Victory screen fix - victory screen menu was not showing up after beating a boss.

notes.title: Akumi Wars 0.0.10 - Soft-lock/ Ghost-hitting Patch #2
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

• Attempting to fix soft-locks and ghost-hits.
• Tirax is changed to Guardian class. (Was Paladin class.)
• Guardian Potion is renamed "Liv Potion" now procs heal over time 3 turns. Cooldown: 1

-Akumi Wars Team

notes.title: Akumi Wars 0.0.10 – Experience Bug Fix Patch
notes.notes:
[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Experience gain is dependent on your level and the enemy’s level. Gaining experience should be much more generous and fluid
[*] Severe lag bug when traveling from Spug City to Cragkeep Mountains fixed. It was a repeating camera pan that never stopped if you skipped the cutscene.
[*] Incentives are now saved each run through. Colosseum incentives are now completable. Which means Tirax can be unlocked.
[/list]
[u][b]New Features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Hero rewards now display the hero's stats.
[*] Rune Fusion shop added to Cragkeep Mountains. Unlocks after Grizzlespit’s upgrade shop. Take any 3 runes and fuse them for a chance at a stronger rune. This consumes the 3 runes used. The power of the 3 runes that we’re fused will determine the potential upgrade of the new rune.
[*] Fara is now “Undead” will come back to life with 40% life when killed. If protected by invincible, the Undead passive will continue to proc for 3 turns. Cooldown: 7
[*] Liv’s second skill “Heal Potions” heals 40% of lost health upon casting.
[*] Drone’s second skill “Battle Ready” heals 40% of lost health upon casting.
[*] Ironhide: All damage received increases physical defenses and resistances 30% and 5% magic defense. Max stacks: 20
[*] New custom skill, Dragonskin: All damage received increases magic defenses and resistances 30% and 5% physical defense. Max stacks: 20 (Can be found in shops.)
[*] New custom skill, Vengeance: For each ally that dies, you gain 100% attack for 2 turns. Max stacks: 10 (Inspired by Caddeus idea) (Can be found in shops.)
[*] Liv’s “Guardian Potion” should be more balanced with the Ironhide change. Previously, Ironhide gained 30% physical AND magical defense along with resistances which at max stacks negated all damage types.  This made the  guardian potion extremely effective. (Can be found in shops.)
[*] Miltonius any damage received, silences the attacker 1 turn.
[*] Jade and Max heroes now have voice audio from the Akumi Xtreme episodes.
[/list]
On to finish Zone 4, Halyon Forest!

-Akumi Wars Team

notes.title: Akumi Wars 0.0.10 - Cragkeep Patch
notes.notes:
[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
Limiting mass proc skills. My computer runs the game well and even I was experience huge slowdowns because of the mass proc calculations happening.

[i][u][b]Heroes[/b][/u][/i]
[list]
[*]  All Guardian and Paladin default skill taunts will ignore resists.

[*]  Paladin’s will now always stun undead targets and cast Holy Fire on the same target for more damage.

[*]  Azumi’s Ultimate: strikes a single target six times for 5% ( was 15% ) of target's max health. The fifth hit stuns a random enemy while the last hit activates all burns and knocks a random enemy. Shock burn duration reduced from 2 to 1.

[*]  Molly’s default skill range increased from 1 to 2. Piracy: All Molly's attacks will steal a buff and apply it to herself with each hit. Stealing a team buff will apply the stolen buff to her whole team. Quick Wit: When critically, hit gains full turn meter. Adrenaline: At 50% health, Molly gains “Lucky Dodge”, significantly increasing her dodge and resistance 3 turns. Cooldown: 4. Focused: All attacks increase her critical hit chance and critical damage 10%. Max stacks: 10)  

[*]  Skeez’s default attack gives double Gambit bonus with each shot. Gambit: 4% increased critical chance ( was 2%) and 2% critical damage (was 1%) for each attack he does. Max stacks: 40.)  Accuracy debuff removed.
Skeez’s “Boomstick” skill gets an extra turn afterwards. Removed Critical chance bonus.
Skeez’s Ultimate: shoots a single target 5 times doing bonus damage for 30% of the target's lost health. These shots can knock the target down. Each shot also increases his turn meter by 10%.
At 75% health, Skeez gains “Lucky Dodge”. Significantly increasing his dodge and resistance 3 turns. Cooldown: 4

[*]  Jade’s “Scattershot”: Jade shoots 3 bolts at a single target. The first shot dissolve target's bubble shield. Her last hit will remove all buffs.  A second target will also be burned with each shot.
[*]  Jade’s “Hadron Collider” skill no longer pierces. Jade fires a bolt at her target that will knockdown and remove all buffs. Will burn a second target with the lowest health. Ignores shields and cannot miss.

[*]  Akumi Defender default skill range increased 1 to 2. Her ultimate range increased from 2 to 3. Her “Ironhide Taunt” will now ignore resists. 

[*]  Akumi Warden’s “Dampening Strike” will now reduces a single target’s attack -80% 1 turn. It will also remove any bubble shields and prevent bubble shields for 2 turns. Her default skill and second skill range increased 1 to 2.
[/list]

[i][u][b]Enemies[/b][/u][/i]
[list]
[*]  Dwarf resistances majorly reduced. Skills: Reconstruct, Repairs, Invincible and all major defense buffs are on a long cooldowns. Resistances reduced. They can be taunted now. Still immune to stuns.

[*]  Demonkiss no longer has invincible before death. Resurrect allies on longer cooldown and no longer gives extra turn.

[*]  Demonkiss Shade’s resurrect allies on longer cooldown and no longer gives extra turn. Ultimate on a long cooldown

[*]  Spug Grunts proc fewer buffs when healed. Lower health pool. 

[*]  Spug Sprite’s, Natural Cleanse, will now heal 40% of lost health.

[*]  Spug Guardians no longer precast attacks. Removed mass healing and shielding.

[*]  Spug Defender will precast mass bubble shields

[*]  Tecnic gains Battle Frenzy and Superior Defense if his wolf is killed. Wolves gain 50% turn meter when an ally dies.

[/list]
[i][u][b]Skills[/b][/u][/i]
[list]
[*]  Emeralds now passively heal the caster for percentage of their max health while maintaining it’s healing power and healing received bonuses.

[*]  Warrior Saint: Your attacks will heal the lowest health ally 24% of their lost health while your healing power is and healing received increases 5%. Max stacks: 10 (Similar to Drones Mending Bolt.)

[*]  Speed Demon gives extra turn when enemy dies. Cooldown removed.
[/list]

Zones
[list]
[*]  Stoneshore Gateway: removed Souless and Demonkiss the Haunted as possible spawns.
[*]  Vengeance: Fight with Salty Skeltor now optional.
[*]  Western Kingdom renamed “Merc Quarters”. (Braxus encounter) is now optional.
[*]  Spug Gateway labeled (optional)
[*]  Colosseum opens after Spug Prince cutscene.

[/list]

Enjoy these changes! We're working on Zone 4 next! Halcyon Forest, Realm of the Elves!
Onwards and Upwards!

- Akumi Wars Team

notes.title: Akumi Wars Demo Version 0.0.8 - Spug City
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Brand new zone open, Spugnolia! Home to Spug City, where Akumi lives!
[*] When hero’s are critically hit, new blood splatter FX on screen.
[*] When heroes critical hit an enemy, new camera shake.
[*] Many new skills focused on passive stacking of statuses to buff your damage, defense, healing and more!
[*] New consume/activate DoT skills. Skills that can activate and/or consume DoTs on a target to have all the damage it would do over time happen immediately.  Can also be used to heal caster.
[*] New Demonkiss shop focused on selling unique and powerful offensive skills at a higher price. Need gold? Skills can also be sold here for a higher price.
[*] New character Jade: Focuses on piercing shots that damage and removing buffs from her targets. Does your enemy have too many heals, shields and other buffs? Jade says begone!
[*] New character Trena: Jade’s sidekick who compliment each other’s attacks. Trena, the agile beast girl, who can constantly stack marks on her target to take more and more damage. Great at disposing of single targets with ease.
[*] New Character Caddeus: Don’t let his looks fool you. This fire-breathing lizard has ironhide skin that continues to increase the more he gets hit!
[*] New Character Liv:  Focuses on root attacks that reduce enemy turn meters and slows their attacks. She also has a new healing method where she can heal her primary target and then place a second delayed heal on the lowest health ally.  This second heal will activate in 2 turns. It’s a life saver!
[*] New enemy weaknesses. The Scarlet demons seem to take little damage from your heroes until you add fire to the mix. First enemies to take more damage from a specific element.
[*] New upgrade shop.  Got duplicate skills of the same type and level? Go to the Upgrade Shop and combine 3 of them into 1 stronger version. New common items have been added that can be upgraded: 3 Normal Potions can be upgraded into 1 Epic Potion. 3 Epic Potions can be upgraded into 1 Legendary Potion.  New “1Up Shrooms” can also be upgraded.
[*] Many new cutscenes.
[*] Many, many new character skill kit revamps! Example: Akumi gains attack stacks the more she attacks with her sword making her a power house the longer the fights go. Her ultimate attack now activates all DoTs on her target for bonus damage. Stack them DoTs before using her ultimate attack!
[*] Now you can read Hero bios to get tips on how to best use their skills!
[*] New skills that give bonus critical damage to stunned targets. 
[*] Many new Hero Skin rewards.
[*] Probably more stuff but too much to remember. Have fun![/list]

notes.title: Demo Build 0.0.6 Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello Playtesters,

There's been a ton of polish and work added to this build. We're giving you access to all the characters and skills in this build to test out again.

Updates:
[list]
[*] Turns between character actions have been sped up significantly.
[*] Frame-rate slow-down has been drastically reduced. Tulio fixed some performance issues and I turned off looping for a lot of visual effects like the healing over time animation. These we're a major reason for slow-down.
[*] Damage and heal over time effects are now played individually.  Characters will now play a pain animation along with sound and visual effect for each DOT they have on them.  Some dots have been reworked to have a more consistent effect: Poisons reduces healing and does damage to remaining health. Bleeds reduce damage and does damage to remaining health. Burns do a percentage of target's max health as damage.  This can be slightly varied from character to character.
[*] Many menu polish updates: shop item tooltips, tooltips for characters in victory screen
[*] New characters:  Miltonius, Tirax, Soybean, Chaz, Scarlet Betrayer
[*] Chad minor rework
[*] Level 20 big boss test nodes:  "Timeless Titan" and "Scarlet Fiend" (Extremely Difficult)
[*] New settings options: fullscreen/ windowed, resolution options and a quit button!
[*] New voiceover audio added to Akumi and Drone in the first cutscene.
[/list]

Let us know what you think in the Akumi Wars Discord. Remember to press F5 on the title screen!
Onwards and Upwards!

-Akumi Wars Team
